prompt: Compose a bebop head in Eb major, 203 BPM allegro, 4/4, about 96 bars and about three and a half minutes, scored for sax, piano, bass and drums in 4 voices. Texture: fast eighth-note lines with chromatic approach over chained ii-V-I. Open with 4 bars of sax alone, then layer the other parts in one at a time. The main section runs on a 4-bar diatonic loop of I–V–vi–IV, unchanged throughout. Thin the middle section to two voices for two descending phrases, then return with everything for the fullest passage. Dynamics start at mp, push to f in the middle and settle back to mp for a sustained tonic close. Aim for the feeling of leaves in an autumn courtyard. Use no ornament symbols; write every note out. Output the complete piece as ABC notation.

prompt: Compose a piano duet for four hands in Bb major, 117 BPM moderato, 4/4, about 64 bars and about three minutes, scored for piano four hands in 4 voices. Texture: the upper pair leading and the lower accompanying, swapping at each section. Open with 4 bars of piano four hands alone, then layer the other parts in one at a time. The main section runs on a 8-bar diatonic loop of vi–IV–I–V, unchanged throughout. Thin the middle section to two voices for two descending phrases, then return with everything for the fullest passage. Dynamics start at mp, push to f in the middle and settle back to mp for a sustained tonic close. Aim for the feeling of leaves in an autumn courtyard. Use no ornament symbols; write every note out. Output the complete piece as ABC notation.
